source_engine.description: framework.yaml: bpmn_source_engine, recorded so a reader knows which execution semantics the carried-over .bpmn files assume. The framework has no opinion on the target engine.

conventions_hash.description: Hash of the whole target-conventions.yaml this pack was assembled against. A conventions change invalidates the API contract and the scenario bindings, so this must equal the hash those artifacts recorded.

conventions_sections_recorded.description: Whether each section of target-conventions.yaml was authored. api and identity are REQUIRED — c7 refuses to run without them, so false here cannot occur in a passing pack and is a bug in the assembler. process and ui are RECORDED-only: false is a legitimate, shippable state meaning the decision was not written down. Recording it per-section is what keeps 'nobody decided which engine runs these processes' a statement rather than a silence — the same null-versus-absent discipline the value facts use.

spec_validation.description: Carried from d1's report (schemas/d1-run-spec-validation.schema.json). Present in the manifest so that how much of the spec was actually checked against the running legacy application is readable from the pack itself, not only from whoever set framework.yaml. contradicted is absent by construction: a contradicted rule fails the gate, so a shipped pack has none.

rules_total.description: Every active lifted RULE in the pack. The denominator — out_of_scope against this is the number that says how much of the framework's central claim went unchecked.

open_questions_seeded.description: How many open-questions entries this assembly seeded. Reported rather than gated: a pack with none is not a better pack, it is usually a pack whose upstream steps stopped recording what they could not decide.

kind.description: original: the only place this content exists. projection: regenerated from an original, must regenerate byte-identically. derived: computed once from originals plus a human input (the API contract). verbatim_copy: byte-identical to a legacy source file (.bpmn). generated_index: manifest and README. mutable_seed: created empty and thereafter owned by the implementer (progress.jsonl) — excluded from hashing and regeneration checks. seeded_append_only: written non-empty by the pipeline and appended to by the implementer afterwards (open-questions.jsonl) — its sha256 records the seeded content at handover, and later divergence is expected rather than a failure, so it is excluded from the regeneration check. reference: a captured artifact nothing in the pack derives from or checks against (reference/screenshots/) — its sha256 is tamper-evidence at handover, and re-running the capture is NOT expected to reproduce it, so it is excluded from the regeneration check. carried_input: a human-authored input file copied in verbatim for the implementer (handover/target-conventions.yaml).

source.description: For projection/derived/verbatim_copy: what it was produced from. Required for anything that is not an original.

sha256.description: Absent for kind mutable_seed — that file changes by design.
